# Apple splits its iPhone 18 launch across two seasons

Maya Brooks

Photo: Hannerdy / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0)

Apple is doing something it has never done with its iPhone lineup: splitting the launch across two seasons. The iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max and Apple’s first foldable iPhone are expected to debut in September 2026, while the standard iPhone 18 won’t arrive until spring 2027. [...] Three devices are expected in September: the iPhone 18 Pro, the iPhone 18 Pro Max and the iPhone Fold, Apple’s first foldable phone. The standard iPhone 18 follows months later in spring 2027.
